proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12918 saṃdhyā gives sañjhā/sā̃j/sā̃z evening. These affricate/fricative variants identify the evening family. Reviewed comparison: KochilaTharu sãj “evening” (f_obqxf7nu7ewui). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
